description.p: Jot is a Markdown notes app for Linux. Notes are plain files in a folder you choose, and sync is optional: none, a folder another tool already syncs, S3, Dropbox or Google Drive.
Jot is at an early stage. It shares its look and its themes with Callie, the calendar from the same makers.

ul.li: Open a folder of Markdown notes as your vault. The sidebar lists its notebooks, which fold, and its tags; the middle column lists their notes, newest or by title, and searches them; Ctrl+P finds any note by a few letters of its title, an alias or its folder.

Write notes in Markdown that styles itself as you type: headings grow, and the marks behind emphasis, links and code fold away except on the line you are on. Notes save as you type. Ctrl+N makes a note, its title renames it and every link to it, Ctrl+click follows a link (or makes the note a wikilink names), and a click ticks a task.
Paste an image, or drop files on a note, to keep them beside it in its .assets folder. An image on a line of its own shows in place of its link.
Under each note, the lines that link to it, and the notes that name it without a link. Resting the pointer on a link shows the start of the note it leads to.
To-dos, in the sidebar: notes that are to-dos, soonest due first, and every unticked box in the vault. Ticking one changes its note; choosing one opens the note on that line.
jot status, ls, search, new, show, open and todo work on your vault from a terminal, with --json for scripts; jot new takes a note's body from a pipe.

A row of formatting over each note: headings, bold, italic, strikethrough, code, links, lists, checkboxes, quotes and code blocks, each also undone in one step, and most with a shortcut. The To-do button makes the note a to-do, with a due date and a Done switch under its title.

Settings, under the title bar's slider button or Ctrl+,: change the notes folder, pick, import, export or recolor a theme, and turn off the daily check for new releases. The ? menu copies debug info, reports a bug, lists the keyboard shortcuts, says what is new, and tells you when an update is out.
jot upgrade and jot downgrade install another release, jot logs and jot doctor help with bug reports, and the jot command completes in bash, zsh and fish.
A first window with Callie's look: the shared themes, a rounded frame and its own title bar.
.deb and .rpm packages for Fedora, Debian and Ubuntu.
